name: comment-diet
description: Puts your comments on a diet: one line, or none. A Claude Code hook that blocks useless comments as an agent writes them.

plugins.name: comment-diet
plugins.description: Puts your comments on a diet: one line, or none. Blocks multi-line comment blocks, banners, narration, and road-not-taken comments as they're written, scoped to the current change. Configurable via .comment-diet.json; no dependencies.
